scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.search:up: npm run search:env && docker-compose --env-file searxng/.env -f searxng/docker-compose.yml -p caster-chatbot-search up -d
scripts.search:down: npm run search:env && docker-compose --env-file searxng/.env -f searxng/docker-compose.yml -p caster-chatbot-search down
scripts.search:logs: npm run search:env && docker-compose --env-file searxng/.env -f searxng/docker-compose.yml -p caster-chatbot-search logs -f searxng
